title: Closed immersion cancellation against a separated morphism
statement: Let Z\to Y\to X be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If Z\to X is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and Y\to X is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], then Z\to Y is a closed immersion.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 07RK (lemma-immersion-permanence), part (3), statement and proof, lines 220-246

mathlib_searches.query: closed immersion of a composite and separated second morphism imply the first morphism is a closed immersion

mathlib_searches.results: IsClosedImmersion.of_comp has hypotheses IsClosedImmersion (f ≫ g) and IsSeparated g, concluding IsClosedImmersion f

mathlib_match.how: The lemma specializes to Z -> Y by taking the composite Z -> Y -> X as the closed immersion and the second map Y -> X as separated.
